title: Florida, Louisiana and meeting King Oliver at the Graystone
summary: His Florida work was with Oliver; he met Oliver in 1928-29 when Oliver's band and Jean Goldkette's shared the Graystone; Benbow's revue was the Get Happy Revue.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: What about Florida? Where did you play in Florida? And was this with the same traveling group?
Well, we didn't do too much with that particular show in Florida. All the stuff I did in Florida was with King Oliver.

I see. And Louisiana...? According to John Chilton's Who's Who Of Jazz, you were in Louisiana around this time, generally around the time that you went to Cuba. Do you recall anything outstanding about playing in Louisiana?
I was in Louisiana in 19... Same time I was with Benbow. All these places that... I just remember not when it was, but where it was. It was around about, oh, forty or fifty years ago almost...
In other words, did you play in Louisiana before you met King Oliver?

Yes. I went before I met King Oliver. I met King Oliver in 1928-29. That's before then. As I said, I played the Graystone Ballroom with King Oliver. Two bands was featured there, Jean Goldkette's band and King Oliver's band. That place there that I just mentioned...the Graystone Ballroom...
Yes. He went there, but he didn't stay very long. About two nights. He was on a tour.
Benbow's revue was known as the Get Happy Revue, wasn't it?
